terra.problem: The passage says Joash did right while Jehoiada instructed him, but it does not establish that his faith depended on Jehoiada or describe what happened when Jehoiada was gone.

Joash’s payment to Hazael does not establish that he never learned to turn to the LORD himself. The passage does not say whether he prayed, and it does not identify borrowed faith as the reason for his action.
